name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: The biggest movement this period is the 1,300% spike in leads week-over-week (paired with an 86.88% drop in CPL), almost certainly driven by the 83.71% surge in spend and Meta's 18 leads at a $91.55 blended CPL carrying the full lead volume. Google Ads contributed 10 conversions on $965.38 in spend but note a reconciliation gap: GHL shows 1,597 opportunities and 53 won against only 18 tracked leads on the ad platforms, and since both sources are active these figures are unreconciled.

performance.verdict: CPL collapse is real but 9 critical SOW milestones are overdue, blocking scale.

findings.text: CPL dropped 86.88% to $91.55 blended — driven by Meta's 18 leads this week vs near-zero prior; Google's 10 conversions add volume but remain unreconciled with GHL's 1,597 opps.

9 SOW milestones overdue by 5–66 days: intake owner unconfirmed (blocks scale-up gate), booking bot untested, Review Boost not live, Financing page missing, Homer Glen branch missing, LSA heating not re-enabled, heating/furnace content not indexed, Fall creative not delivered, Heating campaigns (Google & Meta) not live.

GBP 'Quality HVAC Solutions' call rate is 1.47% on 954 impressions (23 calls/28d); flagged gbp_low_call_rate. GBP actions dropped 64% week-over-week — organic demand signal is fading while paid ramps.
3-day lead signal (Oct 3–5): 0+1+0 = 1 lead on $34.07 spend, versus prior 3 days (Sep 30–Oct 2): 5+2+3 = 10 leads on $251.93. The lead burst was a 3-day window event, not a sustained trend.

GHL shows 1,597 opportunities created and 53 won (value $4,399.45) against only 18 ad-platform tracked leads in 28 days — a 88x gap suggesting most pipeline entries are not from paid ads; intake attribution is broken.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner in GHL and test speed-to-lead automation — unblocks scale-up gate per SOW.
suggestions.monday_update: The SOW intake-owner milestone (due 2026-08-31) is unconfirmed and is the explicit gate blocking any budget scale-up. Vivian left 7/7 and no replacement seat has been verified. Nacer or Xavier must confirm the active GHL login, after-hours coverage, and that speed-to-lead automations are routing correctly. Success check: named owner confirmed with active GHL session and one test lead routed end-to-end by 2026-10-10.

suggestions.text: Reconcile GHL 1,597-opp vs 18 ad-tracked leads gap; identify attribution source to isolate intake leak from ad undercount.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL reports 1,597 opportunities created and 53 won against only 18 leads tracked across Meta and Google Ads in the same 28-day window. This gap means either non-paid sources (LSA, organic, direct calls) are driving the bulk of pipeline untagged, or opp creation is misconfigured and inflating numbers. Pull the opportunity source breakdown in GHL and map it against LSA dashboard exports and GBP call logs. Success check: a source-tagged opp report produced by 2026-10-10 that accounts for the 1,579-opp delta.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL and daily lead rate for 3 more days before any budget move; burst may not hold.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 18 leads at $91.55 blended CPL in the recent 7-day window, but the 3-day trailing signal (Oct 3–5) shows only 1 lead on $34.07 — the burst appears to have been a short cluster not a sustained rate. Do not raise Meta budget until 3 consecutive days of leads are confirmed. Re-check on 2026-10-09; if daily lead rate returns to 2+ per day and CPL holds below $120, escalate to a budget_shift recommendation.
